name: Maximum-Generated Classes and Monotone Boolean Substitution
statement: For every nonconstant coordinatewise monotone Boolean function, substitution preserves and reflects membership in $\mathsf{MaxMin}$, including functions whose formulas repeat variables. Input-coordinate reflections extend this to unate functions; constant tests reduce to a section times a cube.
proof: The zero set of a monotone function is a downset. Minimal one-supports outside it and minimal zero-supports outside its complement define a strict convex cone realizing the associated three-section class. A maximum parent follows from strict realization, and the fixed-test criterion gives preservation. Restricting the test to an edge on which the function changes recovers the input class as a section, proving reflection.
